assertions: Produces exactly two Takes unless a third independent model exists

test_cases.input: Interrogate this field. Account A (store manager): 'Q3 sales fell 18% because the new highway bypass diverted drive-by traffic starting in July.' Account B (district supervisor): 'Q3 sales fell 18% because the manager cut weekend staffing in July and service collapsed.' No decision log exists. Run the one-pass interrogation.
test_cases.name: two_takes_one_collision

test_cases.input: ifs deep dive on this systemic field: why did the Riverside community garden collapse in its third year? Competing causal explanations: (A) the founder's departure removed the only organizer; (B) the parks department's new lease terms made the plot financially unviable; (C) volunteer transience — no cohort stayed longer than one season. Run the full nine-stage deep run with explicit QUESTION and TEST stages.
test_cases.name: deep_run_has_question_and_test

assertions: Tags inputs by tier and never upgrades CLAIM or OBSERVATION into FACT
Missing critical variables classified UNKNOWN, not filled in
test_cases.input: Interrogate this field. FACT (verified): the warehouse inventory count on 2026-09-01 was 412 units. OBSERVATION (secondhand report): a driver says he saw 'about 300' units on 2026-09-15. OBSERVATION (secondhand report): a clerk says the manager ordered a recount 'sometime in September' — the exact date is not recorded. CLAIM (actor): the manager claims 'shrinkage has been zero all quarter.' No shrinkage records were provided. Tag every input by evidence tier, and classify what is missing.
test_cases.name: evidence_discipline
